title: Nebius Expands AI Builder Program to Europe with $10M Support

tickers.name: Nebius Group N.V. Class A Ordinary Shares

summary:
The AI infrastructure provider is offering compute grants and venture capital connections to help open source developers transition their work into scalable companies. Nebius is extending its AI Builder Program to European markets with $10M in total support for those creating open models, coding agents and evaluation tools. The rollout begins this week at the NVIDIA GTC conference in Berlin in partnership with Accel and a network of European venture firms.

Selected members gain access to compute credits for the Token Factory service, direct office hours with engineers and runnable code examples. Participation is free for developers who are handpicked by the company to receive funding and resources. This expansion follows the Nebius Global AI Hackathon conducted with NVIDIA, which the firm reports has attracted more than 24,000 participants.

The AI Builder Program is expanding across Europe with $10M in total support across compute grants, capital, and community programs.

Are you building open models, developer tools, or applications on top of them? The program helps builders go from experimentation to scale-up through:

- Compute grants for selected projects in areas such as open models, coding agents, post-training, and evals
- VC connections to help turn open source projects into companies
- Hackathons and demo days with communities including @AITinkerers, @techeurope_ , and @esra_robotics to build, connect, and share your work

We’re kicking off the European expansion this week at #NVIDIAGTC Berlin with @NVIDIAAI, @Accel, and a network of European VCs.

Building AI in Europe? Details below. 👇
